stem.text: Nitrogen and phosphorus are both in Group 15 of the Periodic Table. Phosphorus forms a chloride with the formula $\text{PCl}_5$ but nitrogen does not form $\text{NCl}_5$.
Which statements help to explain this?

items: Nitrogen’s outer shell cannot contain more than eight electrons.
Nitrogen cannot have an oxidation state of +5.
Nitrogen is less electronegative than phosphorus.
